description: Gold evaluation dataset of 20 grounded HR policy Q&A scenarios. Each item lists the expected answer, the expected citation(s) (document + page), and whether the question is answerable by the corpus (in-policy) or must be refused.

questions.question: How many days per week can I work remotely?
questions.expected_answer: Eligible employees may work remotely up to three days per week, with manager approval in advance.

questions.question: Can I work remotely from another country?
questions.expected_answer: Working remotely from outside your country of employment is not permitted without prior written approval from Human Resources.

questions.question: What are the core collaboration hours?
questions.expected_answer: Core collaboration hours are 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM, during which all employees are expected to be available.

questions.question: How many hours is the standard workweek?
questions.expected_answer: The standard workweek is forty hours, typically Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

questions.question: Can I wear jeans to the office?
questions.expected_answer: Clean jeans are allowed on Fridays and on days with no external client meetings.

questions.question: How much notice must I give if I cannot come to work?
questions.expected_answer: You must notify your direct manager at least two hours before your scheduled start time.

questions.question: What is the limit for accepting gifts from vendors?
questions.expected_answer: Accepting gifts valued at more than 50 USD from a vendor or client is prohibited and must be reported to the Ethics Office.

questions.question: How many vacation days do full-time employees get per year?
questions.expected_answer: Full-time employees accrue twenty days of paid vacation per calendar year.

questions.question: How many vacation days can I carry over to next year?
questions.expected_answer: A maximum of five unused vacation days may be carried over; any balance above five is forfeited on December 31.

questions.question: How many consecutive sick days require medical documentation?
questions.expected_answer: An absence of three or more consecutive sick days requires a medical certificate submitted within five business days of returning.

questions.question: How many sick days do employees receive each year?
questions.expected_answer: Employees receive ten paid sick days per calendar year.

questions.question: How long is paid parental leave?
questions.expected_answer: Contoso provides twelve weeks of paid parental leave, taken within twelve months of the child's arrival.

questions.question: How many days of bereavement leave can I take for an immediate family member?
questions.expected_answer: Employees are entitled to five days of paid bereavement leave for the death of an immediate family member.

questions.question: What holidays are company-observed?
questions.expected_answer: Contoso observes eleven paid company holidays, including New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day, plus two floating holidays.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length?
questions.expected_answer: Passwords must be a minimum of twelve characters and include upper, lower, number, and special characters.

questions.question: What is the password rotation frequency?
questions.expected_answer: Passwords must be rotated every ninety days, and the previous five passwords may not be reused.

questions.question: Is multi-factor authentication required?
questions.expected_answer: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all employees accessing company systems, including email, VPN, and cloud applications.

questions.question: What are the data classification levels?
questions.expected_answer: Company information is classified as Public, Internal, Confidential, or Restricted.

questions.question: How quickly must I report a security incident?
questions.expected_answer: A suspected security incident must be reported to the Security Operations Center within one hour of discovery.

questions.question: What is the company's pet adoption reimbursement policy?
questions.expected_answer: Not covered by policy.
